messages:
Ellen V.: opened a tiny docs PR to fix a few Console observability snippets and add an anchor next to the cost table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5177 :wave:
Rico H.: quick skim  saw one dashboard filter using `traceId` and another using `trace_id`. can we standardize to `trace_id`?
Maya P.: will fix to snake_case and update the CSV example headers to match.
Ellen V.: also replace /sdk/node/legacy links I found in two spots -> /sdk/node/current.
Rico H.: Node snippet also missing an await on fetchTrace(); demo app shows empty traces without it.
Maya P.: added the await and changed code fence language to `javascript` for proper highlighting.
Ellen V.: please add a one-line non-technical note under the cost matrix: "Shorter average sequences generally reduce per-token cost by improving batching." keep it simple.
Maya P.: added line. also inserted anchor id="trace-attribution" next to the cost table and a short dashboard filter example: `trace_id = "{{trace_id}}"`.
docs-bot: docs CI passed for PR #5177 (build 4976) :white_check_mark:
Rico H.: reviewed final diffs and left a :+1:; asked to rename `sessId` -> `sessionId` in one helper snippet.
Maya P.: fixed the var name and squashed lint bot commit. re-requesting review.
Ellen V.: thanks all  final plan: merge after one more approval. tagging #product-docs for visibility :sparkles:
__notes: Small Slack thread coordinating docs PR: snippet fixes (await, var name), link replacements, anchor add, cost note, CI pass. Messages are short and Slack-like.
